title: Practical and Private Hybrid ML Inference with Fully Homomorphic Encryption
abstract: arXiv:2509.01253v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In contemporary cloud-based services, protecting users' sensitive data and ensuring the confidentiality of the server's model are critical. Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables inference directly on encrypted inputs, but its practicality is hindered by expensive bootstrapping and inefficient approximations of non-linear activations. We introduce Safhire, a hybrid inference framework that executes linear layers under encryption on the server while offloading non- linearities to the client in plaintext. This design eliminates bootstrapping, supports exact activations, and significantly reduces computation cost. To safeguard model confidentiality despite client access to intermediate outputs, Safhire applies randomized shuffling, which obfuscates intermediate values and makes it practically impossible for a client to reconstruct the model. translated_title: 基于全同态加密的实用且隐私保护的混合机器学习推理
translated_abstract: 在当代基于云的服务中，保护用户的敏感数据并确保服务器模型的机密性至关重要。全同态加密（FHE）能够直接对加密输入进行推理，但昂贵的自举（bootstrapping）操作和非线性激活的低效近似阻碍了其实用性。我们提出了Safhire，一种混合推理框架，它在服务器端以加密方式执行线性层计算，同时将非线性部分以明文形式卸载到客户端执行。这一设计消除了自举操作，支持精确激活，并显著降低了计算成本。为了在客户端能够访问中间输出的情况下保护模型机密性，Safhire采用随机化洗牌技术对中间值进行混淆，使客户端实际上无法重建模型。为进一步降低推理延迟，Safhire还引入了先进的优化技术（如……）
tldr: 提出Safhire混合推理框架，通过在服务器端加密执行线性层、将非线性计算卸载至客户端，从而消除自举操作并显著降低计算成本，同时利用随机化洗牌技术保护模型机密性，实现实用且隐私安全的全同态加密机器学习推理。
en_tdlr: Safhire is a hybrid FHE inference framework that executes encrypted linear layers on the server while offloading non-linearities to the client, eliminating bootstrapping and reducing computation cost, with randomized shuffling to protect model confidentiality.
